notes:
Account snapshot: Horizon Lexicon builds search and knowledge tools for regulated legal firms. Primary need is high-quality RAG for legal Q&A and contract search. Key metrics: target throughput 300 QPS peak, 95th perc latency goal < 100ms for vector fetch + rerank, indexing scale ~200M vectors (initial), budget sensitivity - aiming for <$0.005/query but wants Redwood to model at scale.

Architecture constraints: core dataset lives in Postgres with pgvector extension; several siloed Elastic clusters used for metadata. They want a connector path (pgvector -> Redwood ingest) and a persistable on-prem option for redacted PII.

Model & quality notes: prefer open/Redwood-verified embedding models for control and cost. Interested in candidate generation via vector search + cross-encoder rerank (hybrid pipeline). "Must preserve original doc provenance and highlight redactions."

Security & compliance: infosec requires SSO/SAML, audit logging, KMS integration, data residency in NA for production, and ISO27001 evidence. Legal asked: "Can you prove we won't leak training data?" Need standard NDA + data handling addendum.

Sales posture: AE reports strong technical champion (Dir. of Search - Maya Chen) and economic sponsor (CTO). They are evaluating Redwood alongside Pinecone + custom ELK/pgvector stack. SE workshop identified connector gaps; POC is next.

Quotes from calls: "We need reranking that won't blow up costs at 200M vectors"; "pgvector is non-negotiable for initial ingestion".
